notes.title: Tiny Lands 2 Official Release Date!
notes.content: [p]Hello dear community! [/p][p]We are more than thrilled to share with you this news![/p][p][/p][h2]✨[b]Tiny Lands 2[/b] arrives on [b]November[/b] [b]6th![/b]✨[/h2][p][/p][p]We have been working hard to deliver the best quality and experience on what we aim to be one of the best high-quality spot the difference games out there![/p][p][/p][p]Please take a look at the official game trailer![/p][previewyoutube="dyeVW3uJPag;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][list][*][p]🔎 Hidden jigsaw pieces are scattered through the worlds for those who love the extra challenge with lots of achievements. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]🕹️ You can now play together locally with your loved ones![/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]👁️‍🗨️In case you get stuck on a difference, we included a hint aid system that will mark a radial zone where the difference might be.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]📷 Enjoy and get creative with the new photo mode; use borders, stickers, and other camera effects to share your best/inspiring/masterpiece/funny shot with the community through the Steam gallery.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]This game has been made with so much love in every detail and every level; we really hope you can enjoy it and have a great and relaxing time with Tiny Lands 2. [/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to wishlist and share with your friends the news! [/p][p][/p][p]                                        [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051895/7b623195670020c85ac24b8d4f6e66b21fa4e7f7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Thank you so much! [/b][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]Hyper Three Studio team[/p]

notes.title: Tiny Lands 2 is participating in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello dear community!
We are excited to announce [b]Tiny Lands 2 will be participating in the Steam Next Fest[/b] starting on 24 Feb!

Here are some notes about what's included in the Demo: 

[b]Hint system[/b]: If you get stuck trying to find a difference, use the new Hint System that will display an area where a difference might be ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051895/651d38025e2c82ac18bd85c525086c0e275f6072.gif[/img]

[b]Photo Mode[/b] is now available on the demo!
Enjoy playing around with the photo mode, place stickers, decorate and take your best shot! 
Use #TinyLands2 and share your creations on social media so we can see them!
[img]https://i.ibb.co/fGK98SQx/Photo-Mode-1.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.ibb.co/vxP3BtD9/Photo-Mode-2.gif[/img]

[b]Input changes[/b]:
You can now navigate in the level selection scene by holding the mouse left button + movement (Drag).
We have made improvements in the camera panning and some minor tweaks!

[b]Wanna try the DEMO on your Steam Deck? [/b]
Make sure you find a comfy place, sit down and relax playing Tiny Lands 2 Demo on your Steam Deck without worries ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051895/014558dae24808546118c09b104493f2bb89d5d0.jpg[/img]

There will be a quick form if there is any feedback or bug, so let us know what you think! We want to make Tiny Lands 2 the best “spot the difference game” for you!

Btw, we are running a Steam Gift Cards giveaway to celebrate Tiny Lands 2 support from the community on [url=https://www.instagram.com/hyperthreestudio/]Instragram[/url] so make sure the check it out!

Thank you all for supporting us! have fun!
Sincerely,
Hyper Three Studio team

notes.title: Demo feedback update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! ːtinyloveː

First, we would like to thank everyone who played the [b]Demo[/b] during the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration. ːgachaexcitedː

Special thanks to everyone who took the time to provide us detailed feedback, [b]it has been so helpful to improve the game experience and to make sure we hear our community[/b]! Thank you!! ːgachaloveː

At this moment, we keep working on the game as much as we can to ensure you have an updated version of the DEMO for the upcoming [b]Steam Next Fes[/b]t. 

So, as part of the results here are the things that will be included for [b]Steam Next Fest Demo[/b]: 

[b]Features[/b]: 
[list]
[*] Added [b]“Hint"[/b] system feature, note that hint system will not reveal hidden collectibles, it’s only for differences. 
[*] Added [b]“Photo Mode”[/b] feature
[*] Found differences visibility will [b]persist when you leave the level[/b].
[/list]
[b]Input[/b]: 
[list]
[*] You can now navigate in the level selection scene by holding the mouse left button + movement (Drag). 
[*] You can now PAN the camera view by holding the mouse left button + movement (Drag). Middle mouse button is not used anymore
[*] Zoom out has been increased so you can fully see the whole game level
[*] Rotation has been improved to avoid getting out of the scene
[*] Rotation max speed has been adjusted to avoid super speed when rotating hehe
[/list]
UI:
[list]
[*] Main menu titles are visible with less opacity instead of fully hidden to avoid the player guessing all the menu options.
[/list]
Bugs: 
[list]
[*] Fixed some incorrect gamepad glyphs displaying in the game
[/list]

We might add some other features/improvements in the upcoming weeks but for now these are the main changes based on your last feedback.

Thank you again for providing such precious feedback. ːtinyloveː

notes.title: Wholesome Games Steam Celebration
notes.content:
Hello everyone!! ːtinyloveː

We are excited to announce [b]Tiny Lands 2 Demo[/b] will be available during the [b]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration from Aug 15 to Aug 22[/b]! ːtinyideaː

Let us summarize what's included/supported in the Demo: 

[list]
[*]5 levels
[*]Single-player only
[*]Supports Gamepad
[*]Supports Steam Deck
[*]English language only
[/list]

The Demo gameplay time is around 30-45 min ːtinycoffeeː So you have plenty time to try out other Demos/Games during the event! ːgachachillː

Other important things you should be aware of: ːtinyideaː
[list]
[*] Your game progress from DEMO will NOT be saved for the final release of Tiny Lands 2.
[*] Features like: Photo Mode, Custom Settings and Hint system are not available in Demo. 
[/list]

Remember to [b]add Tiny Lands 2 to your wishlist[/b] to get notified once the Demo is available ːgachaexcitedː

Did we mention you will be able to leave a review on the Demo? ːtinyloveː We are looking forward to hear your opinion about the game to make the experience even better! So, feel free to leave a review and also in-game there will be a "Demo survey" option so you can provide more feedback to us!

By the way, [b]if you find all differences from the Demo, you will see an exclusive ending scene[/b] from Tiny Lands 2 that will not be available in the final version ːgachaexcitedː 

Thank you very much for your support and we hope you enjoy this TINY part of Tiny Lands 2 ːtinyloveː

Best,
Hyper Three Studio team
